method: Actual local /review browser page. Target attachment card selected right femur FJ3365; selected-only isolation hid other meshes. Camera presets and a manual drag were used. Viewer banner showed RH, m, +X left / +Y head / +Z anterior.

views.observation: Whole femur silhouette fit; proximal head and distal condyles visible. Target condyle is part of a continuous unannotated bone surface.
Posterior full-length view; proximal head/trochanter contour and paired distal condylar mass visible. No attachment annotation or boundary is present.
Lateral full-length silhouette; distal end visible but mesh has no labeled popliteal tendon reference or attachment footprint.

views.action: manual pointer drag on the isolated model
views.observation: Oblique rotation changes apparent condylar contours; without source-to-mesh anatomical landmarks or triangle-level evidence, the target patch cannot be delineated reproducibly.

visualLimits: Mesh appearance confirms only that an isolated right femur surface is rendered. The view does not establish exact posterior-superior lateral-condyle boundary, footprint area, triangle IDs, or coordinates. No coordinates were inferred from pixels.
decision: No surface polygon/point/polyline written; geometry null and context_only held.
